options: You're not entirely sure what you just witnessed.
This is going in the journal under 'unexplained.'
You blink twice, but it's still happening.
The universe has a sense of humor, apparently.
You glance around to see if anyone else saw that.
Today is officially the weirdest day of your life.

text_options: A chicken wearing a tiny hat stares at you expectantly.
A squirrel is sitting on your pack. It seems... angry.
You find a sandwich on a rock. It's still warm.
You trip over absolutely nothing and face-plant.
A bird deposits a... gift... directly on your head.
You walk into a low-hanging branch. Classic.
Your own pack swings around and hits you in the face.
You step on a rake. Yes, a rake. In the wilderness.
The absurdity of the moment makes you laugh so hard you feel better.
A friendly animal nuzzles against you. Your spirits lift!
You find a perfectly preserved pie. Don't question it.
The cosmic joke is on someone else today — you feel great!
The chicken drops something shiny before waddling away.
Hidden under the singing rock, you find actual treasure.
The squirrel drops something from its cheeks before fleeing.
You wait. Nothing else happens. You're mildly disappointed.
The moment passes. Life goes on. Somehow.
You shrug and continue your journey, slightly bewildered.
After a long pause, you decide to pretend this never happened.
